deployment.statement: This package PREPARES the REL-02 governed staging release. The release itself — deployment ids, aliases, runtime proofs, provider proof, gate runs — is recorded in OC5R_REL02_STAGING_RELEASE_RECORD.json, never here.

candidate.frontend_sha: the deploy commit — code_sha itself, or a descendant that changes only docs/** and this branch's two governed pairing records
candidate.backend_sha: the same deploy commit as the frontend (one monorepo commit; the gates require frontend == backend == candidate head)

projects.stable_aliases: carup-staging.vercel.app and carup-backend-staging.vercel.app are NOT moved; the pair resolver refuses them as non-candidate origins
projects.git_auto_deploy: disabled (vercel.json git.deploymentEnabled:false) — deploying is an explicit, governed action
projects.git_connection: none — the CarUp Vercel projects have no connected Git repository (OC-P0 cost containment). Vercel therefore assigns no branch alias and injects no VERCEL_GIT_* variables; a release is a CLI upload of a clean detached worktree at the deploy commit (owner decision 2026-10-08).

database.role: canonical staging database (OC-5R DB convergence: SOURCE PASS + DATABASE PASS)
database.migrations: none introduced by OC-5R-REL-02 (no file under database/ changed)

frontend.basis: a NEW named preview alias (REL-02), assigned to the frontend deployment through the Vercel API and read back. The REL-01 aliases are deliberately NOT moved: they keep serving the frozen REL-01 deployment.

backend.basis: a NEW named preview alias (REL-02), assigned to the backend deployment through the Vercel API and read back

procedure: 1. First iteration only: deploy the BACKEND preview of the code SHA first (CLI, clean detached worktree), assign the backend alias above and read it back from Vercel; its /api/health must already state the code SHA and the kill switch. The aliases are NAMED, so a later iteration inherits them: it deploys straight from its deploy commit and moves the same two aliases.

2. Commit ONLY this branch's two pairing records (values above) plus candidate documentation on top of code_sha. Verify that commit with the verify command — it must pass with pairing "present" the first time the records change, and with pairing "absent" when a later code SHA already carries the same records (the deploy commit then adds documentation only). That commit is the deploy commit.

3. From a clean detached worktree at the deploy commit (git status empty; the CLI upload set is exactly the tracked tree), deploy BOTH carup-backend-staging and carup-staging to the PREVIEW target with CARUP_BUILD_SHA / CARUP_BUILD_REF as build inputs (and, on the backend, as runtime env plus COMMUNICATION_OUTBOUND_DISABLED=true) and meta carupSourceSha=<deploy commit>. Assign the two aliases above and read them back. Never move the stable aliases or the REL-01 aliases.

4. Prove runtime identity before any journey: /carup-provenance.json and /api/health both serve the deploy commit, the frontend is paired to the backend alias, the database refs are the staging project only (consistent), OCR custody is canonical (cloudflare/Qwen), general AI is cloudflare/Gemma, and the outbound kill switch is active.
5. Run the deployed provider proof (label oc5r-deployed-provider-proof) and the two staging gates on the deploy commit.
